subject: website
name: EthPage
summary: EthPage, a viewer that shows any ENS name as a profile page, open source (MIT) in didierkrux/ethpage. It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: when it opens it reads ENS records through ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com and loads a header image from metadata.ens.domains and a favicon from icons.duckduckgo.com.

connections.name: Ethereum RPC (ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com)
connections.note: ENS record reads when the page opens, without a light client.

connections.name: ENS metadata service (metadata.ens.domains)
connections.note: Header image fetched when the page opens.

connections.name: DuckDuckGo icons (icons.duckduckgo.com)
connections.note: Favicon fetched when the page opens.
